data.title: Iran sees victory in Trump’s midterm losses, likely to harden in US talks | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei warned against the ‘slightest inclination towards submission,’ a message hardliners believe was aimed at Iran’s negotiators, CNN reported.
